description: Verifies the spectral colour pipeline: the CIE 1931 colour matching functions at characteristic wavelengths, the conversion of a solar blackbody spectrum to positive linear sRGB, and the bounds and monotonicity of the logarithmic and ACES tone mapping operators.

checks.label: the luminosity function peaks near 1 at 555 nm
the blue matching function exceeds 1 at 450 nm
the red matching function exceeds 1 at 600 nm
the solar blackbody has positive tristimulus values
the solar blackbody converts to positive linear sRGB
the logarithmic mapping preserves brightness ordering
the ACES curve clamps an overexposed colour to at most 1
